transformation.name: Transformation: What Stays the Same When Everything Changes
transformation.truth: Identity preserved under transformation. What stays the same when everything changes? Invariants define structure; transformations reveal what matters.
transformation.qfep_connection: Transformations modify system states while preserving essential structure. In QFEP, transformations are the operations that change S while maintaining coherent identity. They are the grammar of change.

transformation.demonstration: Translate: move without changing. Rotate: spin without deforming. Scale: grow without breaking. Combine transformations and see order matters.

artifact_groups.rationale: Three cubes, three transformation types. Introduces translate, rotate, scale through transport cubes as navigational infrastructure.
Translation as navigational infrastructure: axis-constrained movement, transport cubes, pickup collection gates.
Translation deconstructed into X, Y, Z axes with sliding obstacles and demo objects.
Rotation as non-commutative composition: same operations in different orders produce different outcomes.
Long processional corridor with rotation-carved geometry and layered rotational finale. Integration of rotation concepts.
Scale as relational change: interactive scaling against reference geometry. Callbacks to prism_block and cube_scene from primitives.
